scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to acknowledge customer's severe trauma and fear following an armed home burglary while family was asleep.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Agent never restated the customer's port forwarding problem statement, proceeding directly to procedural checks.

grader.scenario: Port forwarding and DDNS configuration for residential CCTV surveillance system; agent leaves two silences > 30s, ignores burglary trauma, and fails paraphrasing
grader.notes: The agent assisted the customer with establishing port forwarding rules and dynamic DNS configuration for a home security camera DVR system. However, the agent failed Hold Time and Dead Air by leaving two unmanaged silences > 30s (45s at [02:30] and 46s at [07:15]), failed Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement by coldly disregarding Connor's acute panic following an armed burglary at his home, and failed Paraphrasing by never restating Connor's core problem statement.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Agent left an unmanaged silence of 45 seconds at [02:30] and another of 46 seconds at [07:15] without announcing hold or thanking customer upon return.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [01:30] Customer: 'Sean, our house was broken into three nights ago while my wife and two young children were asleep upstairs!... We desperately need this working today!' Agent: 'Let us check whether your broadband connection is assigned a public IPv4 address...' - Complete omission of empathy.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent never offered a restatement of customer's CCTV remote access issue, moving immediately to server lease queries.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: [13:30] Agent correctly recalled port 8000 and 554 without repeating earlier questions.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: [01:10] Agent: 'What specific ports does your CCTV system require?' - Direct technical probing.
